name: Promotion of Acting in Tiatr for School Children
benefit:
##### ***Cash Prizes and Recognition***

- **Monologue (Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹3,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹2,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹2,000/-- **Dialogue (Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹5,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹3,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹2,000/-- **Monologue (Non-Comedy Acting):** 1st Performance - ₹3,000/-; 2nd Performance - ₹2,000/-- **Best Script Writer:** ₹
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a school student at primary school level or secondary school level. - The applicant must participate through their respective school. ##### ***Participation Rules*** - The applicant (one student of a school) can participate in each category. - The applicant must submit separate applications if participating in more than one category. - The applicant must ensure their performance is between 4 to 7 minutes duration. - The applicant must submit a typed copy of the script along with the application form. ##### ***Content Requirements*** - The applicant must ensure their script/performance does not contain any adverse remarks against any governments, individuals, institutions, or anything against caste, creed and religion. - The applicant must ensure their performance does not hurt the sentiments of anybody. ##### ***Competition Categories Available*** - The applicant can participate in Monologue (Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Dialogue (Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Monologue (Non-Comedy Acting) category. - The applicant can participate in Dialogue (Non-Comedy Acting) category. ##### ***Judging Criteria*** Acting abilities are evaluated based on six specific criteria: - Delivery of dialogues - Facial expression - Reaction to others on the stage - Movement on the stage - Costumes - Overall impact ##### ***Performance Guidelines*** - Light effects and background music are not considered during judging. - Performances are limited to acting ability assessment only. - Professional judges with expertise in acting and direction conduct the evaluation.
